id: \rMy father is the Gym Leader around here. His Gym is on the outskirts of the town.
en: \rMy father is the Gym Leader around here. His Gym is on the outskirts of the town.
it: \rMio padre è il Capopalestra di qui. La sua Palestra è alla periferia della città.

id: A maternal Pokémon that raises its young in a pouch on its belly.
en: A maternal Pokémon that raises its young in a pouch on its belly.
it: Un Pokémon materno che alleva i piccoli in una tasca sul ventre.

id: \rThat item ball in there...\nWere you wanting it?
en: \rThat item ball in there...\nWere you wanting it?
it: \rQuella Poké Ball là dentro...\nLa volevi anche tu?

id: An extremely rare Pokémon that was revived from a fossil.
en: An extremely rare Pokémon that was revived from a fossil.
it: Un Pokémon estremamente raro, riportato in vita da un fossile.
Fucsiapoli\nEcco a voi il rosa passione!

id: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring luck to those who manage to get her.
en: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring luck to those who manage to get her.
it: Un Pokémon raro e sfuggente che si dice porti fortuna a chi riesce a catturarlo.

id: \bOur Safari Zone has a zoo in front of the entrance.
en: \bOur Safari Zone has a zoo in front of the entrance.
it: \bLa nostra Zona Safari ha uno zoo davanti all'ingresso.

id: \bOut back is the Safari Game for catching Pokémon.
en: \bOut back is the Safari Game for catching Pokémon.
it: \bSul retro c'è il Gioco Safari per catturare Pokémon.

id: The very image of a Poké Ball.
en: The very image of a Poké Ball.
it: Il ritratto sputato di una Poké Ball.

id: \bYou there! You think you're good enough to enter my Safari Zone?
en: \bYou there! You think you're good enough to enter my Safari Zone?
it: \bEhi, tu! Credi di essere abbastanza bravo per entrare nella mia Zona Safari?
\bNon fare niente di avventato là dentro.
